senses.zh_definition: 霍根：爱尔兰来源的姓氏，也见于艺名；具体人物须由全名或上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A surname of Irish origin, also occurring in stage names.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang berasal dari Ireland dan turut terdapat dalam nama pentas sesetengah tokoh.
senses.nuances: 属专有名词，正文写作Hogan。Hulk Hogan和Ben Hogan是不同人物；孤立词形不足以确定所指。本条仅处理姓氏读法，不据此排除其他语言中的同形词。马来语释义为编写说明，并非DBP原文；以下为人物姓名组合，不是已核定频率的普通词搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Hogan is an English rendering of the Irish surname Ó hÓgáin. The ancestral personal name Ógán contains a diminutive associated with Irish óg, meaning young. The surname therefore records descent from a named ancestor. Its older linguistic associations belong to Irish naming history and should not be treated as meanings of a Malay word. [Dictionary of American Family Names via FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=hogan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把Hogan的声音连到中文姓氏“霍根”；看到Hulk Hogan或Ben Hogan时，先用前面的名字辨认人物。
